exposure: high uterine Natural Killer cell (uNK) concentrations
cohort: 136 women diagnosed with recurrent reproductive failure (recurrent miscarriage and recurrent implantation failure after IVF/ICSI treatment) who had a timed midluteal endometrial biopsy taken for uNK cell analysis.
finding: Despite prednisolone significantly decreasing uNK cell concentrations, there was no significant beneficial effect for prednisolone therapy on pregnancy outcomes (live birth, miscarriage, implantation rates) or complications.
